title: Ten-Channel Pocket Harmonica
description: One complete static pocket harmonica exterior: two complete curved finite-thickness metal covers around one connected wooden comb with ten real front-open air channels, eleven whole dividers/end walls and a continuous rear spine. Three editable closed solids and two opaque solid PBR materials. The mouths are real assembled gaps, not ten black rectangles painted on a solid block. No separate ten-pipe array, keyboard tines or whistle lanyard. Metres, Z up, horizontally centred, lower cover finite flat face at Z0. Small fixed cover-to-spine overlaps are declared mounts. Internal reeds, reed plates and fastener details are intentionally not represented in this lightweight visual model; no tuning, sound, airflow, manufacturing, animation or safety performance claimed.
